What Is The Answer and Why?
Strange, it seems the book only serves as an entry to an actual physical zone... somewhere.
entries.target: 奇怪的是，这本书似乎只是作为一个真正的物理区域的入口……在某个地方。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#You hear a terrible shriek, followed by the rustling of pen and papers.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你听到一声可怕的尖叫，接着是钢笔和纸的沙沙声。

entries.source: A strange creature sporting 7 formless tentacles each with some kind of pen attached. It is ever focused on its book and does not seem to notice you, yet you can feel its hatred and hostility towards you.
entries.target: 一只奇怪的生物，长着七条无定形的触手，每条触手上都绑着某种笔。它始终专注地盯着自己的书，似乎没有注意到你，但你却能感受到它对你的仇恨与敌意。
